source_full: They thought he had found it, And asked no more questions. When Niels left the castle, he shut the door behind him, And it closed with such a bang that the porter woke up. He could scarcely believe his eyes when he saw the three headless giants lying in a heap in the courtyard, And could not imagine what had taken place.
